title: ‘The Pitt’ Team Explains “Friction” With New Doctor, Characters’ Mindset at Top of Season 2: “The People They Want to Be Perceived as Being”
summary: Castmembers Supriya Ganesh, Taylor Dearden and Gerran Howell reveal what their characters have been up to in the 10 months in between seasons while executive producers John Wells and R. Scott Gemmill and star Noah Wyle reveal their thoughts on Netflix's proposed Warner Bros. acquisition and what it might mean for their HBO Max show.
